newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens partners with Bertelsman venture.
newsitem.headline: Siemens partners with Bertelsman venture.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Wednesday it formed a technology partnership with an online services venture of media giant Bertelsmann AG.
Under the partnership, Siemens' private communications network (PN) unit would provide technology to enable the online service of MediaWays GmbH to carry telephone and video communications.

MediaWays provides networking services for German, Austrian and Swiss companies, and wanted Siemens' help to expand into multimedia services. The company is a venture of Bertelsmann and Debis Systemshaus GmbH, the financial and communications services unit of car maker Daimler-Benz Ag.

For Siemens, whose private networking group makes cordless, mobile and standard telephone sets, the partnership furthered its push into Internet-related businesses. Last year the company formed a unit in the United States to develop products for Internet commerce.

"MediaWays has a lot of experience in building and running online networks," said PN board member Werner Schuecking. "Siemens brings its know-how in network integration, speech communication and system solutions to the partnership."
